topic: Repository Layout & Mobile Gradle Project Structure Decision

planned_modules.mobile/shared: Kotlin Multiplatform domain core (Active, compiles JVM/Android/iOS XCFramework)
planned_modules.mobile/android: Android Native application module (To be bootstrapped at Wave M5)
planned_modules.mobile/ios: iOS Native Xcode project (To be bootstrapped at Wave M5, consumes compiled OTravelzCore.xcframework)

rationale: Retains unified Gradle version catalog (mobile/gradle/libs.versions.toml) for shared and Android dependencies, eliminating version skew.
Decouples iOS from Gradle execution: iOS engineers open OTravelz.xcodeproj in Xcode directly without executing Gradle build steps during everyday SwiftUI development.
Applying Ponytail minimalism: avoids creating separate Android root or multi-repo submodules.
STRICT EXECUTION RULE: Do NOT create :android in mobile/settings.gradle.kts or create build files in mobile/android/ during M0 or M0.5. Bootstrap occurs strictly at Wave M5.
